outcome: All tax screens live under one Taxes menu entry with a plain 'file and pay' headline, and rental turning points (signing, a rental nearing its end, a decided ending, untimed visits) create draft visits and dated To do items with working buttons
risk: A broken or missing link after the tax pages move, a To do that duplicates or links to a page that does not exist, a second pickup visit created by a repeat, or a draft that sends or charges something.
next: Both subsections are implemented in one PR; remaining work is exact-head CI, review dispositions and merge. W-5 (payment links and phone payment) is the next bundle.

references.purpose: Four Taxes tabs and Setup list
Ending-soon, pickup and untimed-visit To do rows

invariants: Drafts never send, charge or dispatch anything.
Only OWNER/ADMIN decide an ending; only OWNER changes the reminder setting.
A repeated ending decision never creates a second pickup visit.
Dates are Denver business dates; due dates for tax come from the filing calendar.
sequence: Taxes layout, tabs, moved pages and redirects.
Draft pickup visit and To do rows.
Tests, docs, one push and exact-head CI.
acceptance: The desk menu has one "Taxes" entry (replacing "Sales tax") whose tabs are To file, Use tax, Rates & areas and Setup; Exemptions and What's taxed live under Setup as "Customers who don't pay tax" and "What gets taxed", and the audit pack and record keeping are reachable from Setup.
Use-tax screens live inside Taxes, the old /desk/tax/use-tax-* addresses redirect there, and every link in the app points to the new place.

The sales tax return page and the use tax return page start with one line "File and pay $X on Colorado's sales tax website (SUTS) by <date>" with an Open SUTS link (state and Greeley amounts separate for use tax), then the numbers to copy, then "I filed and paid it"; SUTS and use tax carry plain-words tooltips.
Every money input on the tax screens is typed in dollars, never cents.
Signing creates a draft delivery visit and a To do "Schedule <name>'s delivery" due the next day; nothing is sent, charged or dispatched.
A rental ending within the owner's setting (starting at 30 days) puts one To do on the list with Renew, Month-to-month and Pickup buttons; Renew and Month-to-month only create a draft renewal.

Deciding an ending (pickup chosen, month-to-month end set, or early ending set) creates exactly one draft pickup visit and a To do "Schedule <name>'s pickup"; the draft never sends or charges anything and a repeat creates no second visit.
A visit with no technician or no time 2 days before it is needed gets a To do "Assign / set a time".
